title: 超音波波束形成電子學
summary: 以「接收延遲、取樣率與聚焦波束」展開10單元、40步，包含機制、合成算例、獨立驗證和「延遲量化誤差未列入聚焦」的診斷。
summaryEn: Ten units and forty steps on Receive delays, sampling and focused beams, with mechanisms, synthetic calculations, independent checks and diagnosis of Ignoring delay quantization in focusing.
scope: 五個案例脈絡模型單元加五個明示共通量測方法單元；41類技術方法會重用，395個案例各有獨立焦點與失效情境。數值全部為合成教學假設，來源支持公開原理和方法，不宣稱已查明每個設施的內部規格、完工狀態或現場操作流程。醫療內容僅限數位/惰性台架，不含診療、病人參數或設備操作。
scopeEn: Five case-context model units plus five explicitly shared measurement-method units. Methods recur across 41 technical families, while 395 cases have individual focuses and failure scenarios. All numbers are synthetic teaching assumptions. Sources support public principles/methods, not every facility’s internal specifications, completion status or operations. Biomedical work uses digital/inert benches only, with no treatment, patient settings or device operation.

steps.title: 單元1｜回波距離：機制與界面
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Echo distance: Mechanism and interfaces
steps.objective: 以「接收延遲、取樣率與聚焦波束」完成機制與界面並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete mechanism and interfaces for Receive delays, sampling and focused beams with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「接收延遲、取樣率與聚焦波束」。畫出「合成脈衝 → 聲學介質 → 反射界面 → 接收取樣 → 時差量測」並圈出與「回波距離」有關的介面。將 speed*time/2 每個變數標到圖上，寫明單位、方向及資料來源。解釋：來回飛行時間乘傳播速度再除二給單程距離。 再指出這個局部模型無法回答的項目：此假設速度不是人體、冰或海水的建議值；介質、溫度和折射需另證。
steps.instructionEn: The case focus is Receive delays, sampling and focused beams. Draw Synthetic pulse → Acoustic medium → Reflecting interface → Receive sampling → Timing metrology and mark the interfaces relevant to Echo distance. Place every variable of speed*time/2 on the drawing with units, direction and provenance. Explain: Round-trip travel time times propagation speed divided by two gives one-way range. Identify what it cannot establish: The assumed speed is not a value for tissue, ice or seawater; medium, temperature and refraction need evidence.
steps.observation: 對照「接收延遲、取樣率與聚焦波束」，輸入變數與量測結果不同：先定義可觀察量，再決定能否使用這個式子。前五單元把共通物理模型套入本課案例；這是局部子系統估算，不是整座設施模型。
steps.observationEn: For Receive delays, sampling and focused beams, distinguish inputs from observed outcomes before deciding whether this equation applies. A shared physical model is applied to the case subsystem, not a complete facility model.
steps.failure: 延遲量化誤差未列入聚焦；此假設速度不是人體、冰或海水的建議值；介質、溫度和折射需另證。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring delay quantization in focusing; The assumed speed is not a value for tissue, ice or seawater; medium, temperature and refraction need evidence.
steps.check: 提交標註介面圖及變數表；每個變數有單位與假設/來源/量測標籤，並明列「此假設速度不是人體、冰或海水的建議值；介質、溫度和折射需另證。」。

steps.title: 單元1｜回波距離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Echo distance: Quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以「接收延遲、取樣率與聚焦波束」完成定量估算並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete quantitative estimate for Receive delays, sampling and focused beams with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「接收延遲、取樣率與聚焦波束」的「回波距離」採以下合成教學值：speed=1000 m/s；time=0.0002 s。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 speed*time/2；獨立基準為 0.1 m。把 speed 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 0.11 m。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Receive delays, sampling and focused beams, use synthetic inputs for Echo distance: speed=1000 m/s；time=0.0002 s. Check dimensions before evaluating speed*time/2; the independent benchmark is 0.1 m. Increase speed by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 0.11 m. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: speed增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 0.01 m。此假設速度不是人體、冰或海水的建議值；介質、溫度和折射需另證。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 0.01 m. The assumed speed is not a value for tissue, ice or seawater; medium, temperature and refraction need evidence.
steps.failure: 延遲量化誤差未列入聚焦；此假設速度不是人體、冰或海水的建議值；介質、溫度和折射需另證。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring delay quantization in focusing; The assumed speed is not a value for tissue, ice or seawater; medium, temperature and refraction need evidence.
steps.check: 原值重算與 0.1 m 相符；10%案例與 0.11 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 0.1 m at baseline and 0.11 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（m）？
quiz.explanation: 按 speed*time/2 逐項代入，結果為 0.1；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into speed*time/2 gives 0.1; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元1｜回波距離：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Echo distance: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「接收延遲、取樣率與聚焦波束」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Receive delays, sampling and focused beams with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「接收延遲、取樣率與聚焦波束」設計「回波距離」的獨立驗證：合成兩個已知距離回波，檢查固定觸發延遲與速度斜率能否分離。 比較兩個已知合成界面，分開觸發延遲、聲速假設與回波判讀。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Receive delays, sampling and focused beams, independently verify Echo distance: Use two known synthetic ranges to separate fixed trigger delay from propagation-speed slope. Compare two known synthetic interfaces, separating trigger delay, speed assumptions and echo interpretation. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「延遲量化誤差未列入聚焦」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Ignoring delay quantization in focusing rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 延遲量化誤差未列入聚焦；此假設速度不是人體、冰或海水的建議值；介質、溫度和折射需另證。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring delay quantization in focusing; The assumed speed is not a value for tissue, ice or seawater; medium, temperature and refraction need evidence.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「此假設速度不是人體、冰或海水的建議值；介質、溫度和折射需另證。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state The assumed speed is not a value for tissue, ice or seawater; medium, temperature and refraction need evidence.

把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
optionsEn: Retain raw data and perform: Use two known synthetic ranges to separate fixed trigger delay from propagation-speed slope.
Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.

steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「延遲量化誤差未列入聚焦」。以本單元「回波距離」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「合成兩個已知距離回波，檢查固定觸發延遲與速度斜率能否分離。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Ignoring delay quantization in focusing. For Echo distance, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Use two known synthetic ranges to separate fixed trigger delay from propagation-speed slope. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.

steps.instruction: 本課焦點「接收延遲、取樣率與聚焦波束」的「訊號雜訊比」採以下合成教學值：signal=100 count；background=25 count；noise=5 count RMS。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 signal/sqrt(signal+background+noise**2)；獨立基準為 8.16496581 1。把 signal 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 8.69626357 1。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Receive delays, sampling and focused beams, use synthetic inputs for Signal-to-noise ratio: signal=100 count；background=25 count；noise=5 count RMS. Check dimensions before evaluating signal/sqrt(signal+background+noise**2); the independent benchmark is 8.16496581 1. Increase signal by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 8.69626357 1. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: signal增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 0.531297756 1。假設泊松計數與獨立雜訊；相關條紋、漂移及偏置不滿足此式。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 0.531297756 1. Assumes Poisson counts and independence; correlated stripes, drift and bias violate the model.
steps.failure: 延遲量化誤差未列入聚焦；假設泊松計數與獨立雜訊；相關條紋、漂移及偏置不滿足此式。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring delay quantization in focusing; Assumes Poisson counts and independence; correlated stripes, drift and bias violate the model.
steps.check: 原值重算與 8.16496581 1 相符；10%案例與 8.69626357 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 8.16496581 1 at baseline and 8.69626357 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（1）？
quiz.explanation: 按 signal/sqrt(signal+background+noise**2) 逐項代入，結果為 8.16496581；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into signal/sqrt(signal+background+noise**2) gives 8.16496581; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元2｜訊號雜訊比：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Signal-to-noise ratio: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「接收延遲、取樣率與聚焦波束」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Receive delays, sampling and focused beams with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「接收延遲、取樣率與聚焦波束」設計「訊號雜訊比」的獨立驗證：保留暗場、背景與訊號三組重複資料，分別估計平均與變異。 比較兩個已知合成界面，分開觸發延遲、聲速假設與回波判讀。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Receive delays, sampling and focused beams, independently verify Signal-to-noise ratio: Retain repeated dark, background and signal data; estimate means and variances separately. Compare two known synthetic interfaces, separating trigger delay, speed assumptions and echo interpretation. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「延遲量化誤差未列入聚焦」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Ignoring delay quantization in focusing rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 延遲量化誤差未列入聚焦；假設泊松計數與獨立雜訊；相關條紋、漂移及偏置不滿足此式。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring delay quantization in focusing; Assumes Poisson counts and independence; correlated stripes, drift and bias violate the model.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「假設泊松計數與獨立雜訊；相關條紋、漂移及偏置不滿足此式。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Assumes Poisson counts and independence; correlated stripes, drift and bias violate the model.

保留原始資料並執行：保留暗場、背景與訊號三組重複資料，分別估計平均與變異。
optionsEn: Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.
Retain raw data and perform: Retain repeated dark, background and signal data; estimate means and variances separately.

steps.title: 單元2｜訊號雜訊比：失效診斷與交付

steps.objective: 以「接收延遲、取樣率與聚焦波束」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Receive delays, sampling and focused beams with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「延遲量化誤差未列入聚焦」。以本單元「訊號雜訊比」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「保留暗場、背景與訊號三組重複資料，分別估計平均與變異。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Ignoring delay quantization in focusing. For Signal-to-noise ratio, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Retain repeated dark, background and signal data; estimate means and variances separately. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「延遲量化誤差未列入聚焦」不是單靠 8.16496581 1 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 8.16496581 1 alone cannot exclude Ignoring delay quantization in focusing; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 延遲量化誤差未列入聚焦；假設泊松計數與獨立雜訊；相關條紋、漂移及偏置不滿足此式。

steps.check: 交付單元2的五項證據包；清楚寫出「接收延遲、取樣率與聚焦波束」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 2, stating what the model can/cannot explain for Receive delays, sampling and focused beams and retaining failed cases.
